description: Given one listing, find comparable ones: same operation and area, similar typology, floor area and price. Use this when the user likes a property but wants alternatives — 'find me something similar', 'the same but cheaper', 'what else is there in this area'. Pass `maxPrice` for the cheaper case; without it, comparables are drawn from a band around the reference price. Comparability is by location, typology, area and price, not by text similarity: it answers 'is this well priced for what it is', which a keyword search cannot.

maxPrice.description: Optional budget ceiling, in the market currency. Use it for 'similar but cheaper'; it overrides the default band around the reference price.

slug.description: Slug of the reference listing, as returned by search_properties or get_property_detail.
